rationale: Comparison for unit:given.typing.observations against lean:Unique/Views:positive, lean:Unique/Views:negative, lean:Unique/Views:Pos, lean:Unique/Views:Neg, lean:Unique/Views:Full. positive includes root, proper prefixes of entries and valid descendants of positive entries; negative matches only explicit negative entries. Full quantifies every field of every positive path and requires Pos or Neg. It therefore permits known holes and excludes unknown siblings, matching the definition rather than conflating full with wholly initialized.
